shortDescription: Module for setup of ControllerProperties Avi RESTful Object

options.name: alert_manager_use_evms
options.description: Enable to use event manager as source of eventsdisable to use log manager as source of events. Field introduced in 30.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: allow_admin_network_updates
options.description: Allow non-admin tenants to update admin vrfcontext and network objects. Field introduced in 18.2.7, 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: allow_ip_forwarding
options.description: Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: allow_unauthenticated_apis
options.description: Allow unauthenticated access for special apis. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: allow_unauthenticated_nodes
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_idle_timeout
options.description: Allowed values are 0-1440. Unit is min. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 15.

options.name: api_perf_logging_threshold
options.description: Threshold to log request timing in portal_performance.log and server-timing response header. Any stage taking longer than 1% of the threshold will be included in the server-timing header. Field introduced in 18.1.4, 18.2.1. Unit is milliseconds. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 10000.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: appviewx_compat_mode
options.description: Export configuration in appviewx compatibility mode. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Allowed in essentials (allowed values- false), basic (allowed values- false) edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: archive_retention_framework_period
options.description: Period for archive and retention framework job. Allowed values are 1-240. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Unit is min. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: async_cert_chaining_interval
options.description: Time in seconds to wait before starting async certificate chaining. Allowed values are 0-120. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2.

options.name: async_patch_merge_period
options.description: Period for which asynchronous patch requests are queued. Allowed values are 30-120. Special values are 0 - deactivated. Field introduced in 18.2.11, 20.1.3. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: async_patch_request_cleanup_duration
options.description: Duration for which asynchronous patch requests should be kept, after being marked as success or fail. Allowed values are 5-120. Field introduced in 18.2.11, 20.1.3. Unit is min. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: attach_ip_retry_interval
options.description: Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 360.

options.name: attach_ip_retry_limit
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: bm_use_ansible
options.description: Use ansible for se creation in baremetal. Field introduced in 17.2.2. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: cc_user_password_expiry_days
options.description: Number of days after which cloudconnectoruser (service account) password expires. Rotation is triggered 5 days before expiry. Set to 0 to disable automatic rotation. Allowed values are 1-730. Special values are 0 - disabled. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Unit is days. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 30.

options.name: cc_user_password_rotation_job_period
options.displayName: Cc User Password Rotation Job Period
options.description: Period in hours for cloudconnectoruser (service account) password rotation check job. Default is 24 hours (1 day). Range is 1-168 hours (1 hour to 7 days). Allowed values are 1-168. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Unit is hours. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 24.

options.name: cert_rotation_jwt_retention_days
options.description: Number of days to retain jwt tokens generated during certificate rotation. Use multiples of 30 for months (e.g., 30 = 1 month, 60 = 2 months, 180 = 6 months). Allowed values are 1-3650. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Unit is days. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 180.

options.name: check_vsvip_fqdn_syntax
options.description: Enforce vsvip fqdn syntax checks. Field introduced in 20.1.6. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: cleanup_expired_authtoken_timeout_period

options.name: cleanup_sessions_timeout_period

Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 5.

options.name: cloud_reconcile

options.name: cloud_reconcile_interval
options.description: Time in minutes to wait between consecutive cloud reconcile cycles. Allowed values are 1-1440. Field introduced in 22.1.5, 30.2.1. Unit is min. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 5.

options.name: consistency_check_timeout_period
options.description: Period for consistency check job. Field introduced in 18.1.1. Unit is min. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: controller_resource_info_collection_period
options.description: Periodically collect stats. Field introduced in 20.1.3. Unit is min. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 525600.

options.name: crashed_se_reboot
options.description: Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 900.

options.description: Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 360.

options.description: Minimum api timeout value.if this value is not 60, it will be the default timeout for all apis that do not have a specific timeout.if an api has a specific timeout but is less than this value, this value will become the new timeout. Allowed values are 60-3600. Field introduced in 20.1.7. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: del_offline_se_after_reboot_delay
options.displayName: Del Offline Se After Reboot Delay
options.description: The amount of time the controller will wait before deleting an offline se after it has been rebooted. For unresponsive ses, the total time will be  unresponsive_se_reboot + del_offline_se_after_reboot_delay. For crashed ses, the total time will be crashed_se_reboot + del_offline_se_after_reboot_delay. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Contro

options.name: detach_ip_retry_interval
options.description: Amount of time to wait after last detach ip failure before attempting next detach ip retry. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 60.

options.name: detach_ip_retry_limit
options.description: Maximum number of detach ip retries. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 4.

options.name: detach_ip_timeout
options.description: Time to wait before marking detach ip as failed. Field introduced in 21.1.3. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: dummy
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: edit_system_limits
options.description: Allow editing of system limits. Keep in mind that these system limits have been carefully selected based on rigorous testing in our testig environments. Modifying these limits could destabilize your cluster. Do this at your own risk!. Field introduced in 20.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_api_sharding
options.description: This setting enables the controller leader to shard api requests to the followers (if any). Field introduced in 18.1.5, 18.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.description: When set to true, avi controller will connect to dynamic config streaming agent on nsx manager to get live updates. If it cannot connect, it will fallback to using rest apis based periodic polling. Dynamic streaming is supported from nsx version 4.2.1 onwards. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: enable_per_process_stop
options.description: Enable stopping of individual processes if process cross the given threshold limit, even when the total controller memory usage is belowits threshold limit. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: enable_streaming_based_nsx_ip_group_sync
options.displayName: Enable Streaming Based Nsx Ip Group Sync
options.description: When set to true, avi controller will attempt to automatically sync nsx groups with avi ip groups provided the ip group is configured with an nsx group path and nsx dynamic streaming is enabled and active. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: event_manager_file_modified_ts_filter

Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 180.

options.name: event_manager_max_goroutines

options.name: event_manager_max_subscribers

options.description: This is the max number of file versions that will be retained for a file referenced by the local fileobject. Subsequent uploads of file will result in the file rotation of the older version and the latest version retained. Example  when a file upload is done for the first time, there will be a v1 version. Subsequent uploads will get mapped to v1, v2 and v3 versions. On the fourth upload of the file, the v1 will be file rotated and v2, v3 and v4 will be retained. Allowed values are 1-5. Field int

Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 2.
